$comment: In-app products the iOS release may submit with a version (IOS_SUBMIT_REVIEW). Only these product ids (those whose platforms list ios) are ever attached to App Review; products already approved are left alone. With IOS_CREATE_PRODUCTS on, a v* tag creates every iOS product App Store Connect does not have yet from its `ios` block (fields in store/README.md, Creating products); existing products are never changed and need no `ios` block. Must match SubscriptionProduct in ios/Quit All/Core/PaywallManager.swift and ios/Quit All/Products.storekit (checked by scripts/store/test_ios_release.py). Exported from App Store Connect on 2026-10-14, when all three were APPROVED.
